description: Defines the 'config' class for handling Wesnoth Markup Language (WML) configuration nodes, including methods for managing child nodes, attributes, and differences between configs.

classes.name: config
classes.description: Represents a node in a Wesnoth Markup Language (WML) configuration file, with methods for managing child nodes, attributes, and differences.

methods.name: config()
methods.description: Default constructor for an empty config node.

methods.name: config(const config& cfg)
methods.description: Copy constructor.

methods.name: ~config()
methods.description: Destructor.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator.

methods.name: child_range
methods.description: Returns range of child nodes for a given key.

methods.name: get_children
methods.description: Returns all children with a specific key.

methods.name: all_children
methods.description: Returns a map of all children.

methods.name: child
methods.description: Returns a specific child node by key.

methods.name: add_child
methods.description: Adds a new child node with a given key.

methods.name: add_child_at
methods.description: Adds a child node at a specific position.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Access attribute value by key.

methods.name: get_attribute
methods.description: Retrieves attribute value by key.

methods.name: find_child
methods.description: Finds a child node matching key, name, and value.

methods.name: clear_children
methods.description: Removes all children with a specific key.

methods.name: remove_child
methods.description: Removes a child at a specific index.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the node's data.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the node is empty.

methods.name: get_diff
methods.description: Computes differences between this config and another.

methods.name: apply_diff
methods.description: Applies differences from another config.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends data from another config.

methods.name: merge_children
methods.description: Merges children with the same key.

methods.name: reset_translation
methods.description: Resets translated string values.
